breakdowns.site: Korba Project Site — JCB 3240 Electric Scissor Lift (Warranty) 28-Day Platform Controller Breakdown
breakdowns.issue: A JCB 3240 electric scissor lift deployed under rental contract at Korba has been completely immobilized since 1st September (28 days downtime) due to a defective upper platform controller (PCON) and contactor failure. The machine is actively covered under OEM manufacturer warranty. A complaint was logged on 10th September and part requisition raised on 14th September; however, JCB distributor reported zero stock and failed to provide delivery timelines. Dhruv Sharma strongly reprimanded the service desk for tolerating a month-long breakdown on a warranty machine without high-level escalation.
breakdowns.action: Dinesh assigned full individual ownership of JCB warranty cases. Mandated to post daily reminder email screenshots to the dedicated JCB leadership group (Archit, Prashant, Panchal, Vishal) and attend an urgent 10:30 AM joint review meeting with JCB management to force emergency dispatch of the controller.
breakdowns.status: Critical Warranty Escalation — 28-Day Downtime; JCB Supplier Stockout; Dinesh Assigned Sole Daily Escalation Protocol

breakdowns.site: Zoomlion Scissor Lift Fleet — Battery Bank Deep Discharge Misdiagnosed as Charger Breakdown
breakdowns.issue: A Zoomlion scissor lift reported as experiencing on-board charger breakdown was investigated on-site by technician Manish. The diagnostic revealed the charger hardware was completely intact; the traction battery pack had suffered severe deep discharge, and unauthorized personnel had altered the internal charging profile parameters, preventing the display from initiating charging cycles. The incident highlighted technical misdiagnosis in the field that almost caused an unnecessary, expensive charger purchase.
breakdowns.action: Manish coordinated with Zoomlion technical support, restored the factory charging profile, and successfully revived the battery pack to full operational capacity. Shiv Uniyal and Dhruv Sharma directed engineering staff to document the root cause and inspect charger settings before logging hardware replacements. Pardeep Tomar instructed to explore cost-effective sourcing for one buffer charger in central stock.
breakdowns.status: Resolved & Operational — Charger Restored via Profile Reconfiguration; Deep Discharge Protocol Documented

breakdowns.site: Palsana Site & JK Paper Unit — 3-Ton Forklift Mast Overhaul & Dedicated Transit Commitment

breakdowns.action: Sushil Mishra committed to assigning workshop personnel to complete mechanical cleaning, rust treatment, and servicing today. breakdowns.status: Active Workshop Servicing — Cleaning Underway; 48-Hour On-Site Dispatch Deadline Set by Sushil Mishra

breakdowns.site: Central Fleet Yard / Surat Sardarji Workshop — 3-Ton Crane Motor Rewinding & Clamp Machining Stagnation

Inspection revealed neither the rewinding nor the clamp fabrication has been completed.
breakdowns.action: Sushil Mishra directed to escalate directly with the Surat workshop management today to expedite motor winding testing, collect machined plates, and schedule technician remounting without further delay.
breakdowns.status: Immobilized — Sardarji Workshop Delay; Zero Progress Reported; Direct Management Escalation Underway

directives.title: Strict Warranty Escalation Protocol for OEM Equipment (JCB / Zoomlion)
points: Zero Tolerance for Inactive Warranty Breakdowns: Rental machines under OEM warranty must never sit unattended for weeks. Dedicated warranty handlers (Dinesh) must send formal daily reminders, maintain written audit trails, and post correspondence screenshots to senior management groups.

Management Intervention Threshold: If an OEM distributor or dealer fails to provide tracking details within 48 hours of ticket placement, the issue must be escalated immediately to executive management (Archit/Panchal).

directives.title: Mandatory Technical Root-Cause Verification Before Ordering Electrical Parts
points: In-Depth Diagnostic First: Field engineers must conduct systematic diagnostic checks (voltage drop, deep discharge, profile settings) before concluding an expensive electronic assembly (such as a charger or controller) is damaged.

Prevent Misdiagnosis Costs: Misclassifying deep discharge as a dead charger wastes operational funds and prolongs customer downtime. Technicians must consult OEM technical manuals and verify charging parameters.

directives.title: New Fleet Induction & CRM Warranty Compliance Mandate
points: Immediate CRM Onboarding: Newly purchased equipment (e.g. Hyundai 2-Ton Forklifts) must be registered in CRM on the date of physical receipt, complete with serial numbers, delivery challans, and attachment specifications.
Service & Warranty Protection: Commissioning checklists and PDI certificates must be uploaded immediately to guarantee complete OEM warranty protection.

directives.title: CRM Breakdown Ticket Lifecycle & Field Engineer Accountability
points: Timely System Closure: Service engineers and mechanics must close resolved CRM complaint tickets within 24 hours of machine handoff. Central coordinators must conduct bi-weekly audits to eliminate backlog.
Dual-Engineer Allocation Protocol: CRM workflow team to review and enable multi-engineer assignment capability for complex overhauls requiring joint technician teams.
